data.name: Deadline
data.detailed_description:
Deadline

Deadline plunges you into the heart of indie horror with spine-chilling themes and relentless tension. Developed solo in Unreal Engine, this pixelated survival horror game challenges you to outlast the encroaching darkness across three haunting levels: a sterile Lab, a Creepy Carnival, and a forsaken School. Each environment drags you deeper into a world where every choice could be your last. Your reason for living? Scavenge consumables, extend your Deadline, and chase the ultimate high score. But can you survive long enough to escape?

Key Features:

  • Three Haunting Levels: Explore uniquely unsettling settings;  A sterile Lab with flickering lights, a Creepy Carnival filled with warped attractions, and a haunted School echoing with ghostly whispers. Each level ramps up the dread with distinct challenges and atmospheres.

  • Survival Through Scavenging: Search for consumables like food, batteries, or medical supplies scattered across atmospheric environments to prolong your survival. Every item you find pushes back your Deadline, but hesitation could cost you everything.

  • High-Score Chase: Compete against yourself and friends by surviving as long as possible. Replay levels and memorise item placements to ensure every run can last longer.

  • Pixelated Horror Aesthetic: Retro-inspired pixel art meets Unreal Engine’s atmospheric lighting and effects, crafting a visually striking contrast of nostalgic visuals and modern terror.

  • Immersive Soundtrack: A chilling, original soundtrack amplifies the tension, with eerie ambient noises and heart-pounding cues that react to your actions.

  • Tight, Tense Playtime: Expect a couple hours of gameplay, with high replayability for those hunting perfect runs or higher scores. Perfect for quick, intense sessions or obsessive mastery.

  • Solo-Dev Passion Project: Crafted by a single developer, Deadline delivers a raw, personal horror experience that’s both compact and unforgettable.

Why Deadline Stands Out:

This isn’t just another horror game

It’s challenge that tests your decision making as well as your patience. The pixelated art style blends retro nostalgia with modern technology, while the ever-looming Deadline mechanic creates a constant sense of urgency. Deadline offers indie horror fans a bite-sized yet replayable nightmare that lingers long after the screen fades to black.

Add Deadline to your Wishlist and see how long you can defy the inevitable.
